info.description: Cyber Threat Intelligence Platform read API. M1 exposes anonymous read access to public TLP:CLEAR intelligence with cursor pagination; authentication, RBAC and write endpoints arrive in M2. All errors share a single ErrorResponse shape with a log-correlated traceId (see docs/spec/09-api.md §9.4).
info.title: CTIP API

get.description: Returns every key issued for the caller's tenant, including revoked ones. The key material itself is never returned. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:create。

200.description: API keys of the caller's tenant

post.description: Issues a key for the caller's tenant. The full key is returned exactly once and only its SHA-256 hash is stored; scopes may not exceed the creator's own permissions. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:create。

201.description: Key created; full key returned once

delete.description: Revocation is irreversible. Keys belonging to another tenant are reported as not found rather than forbidden. 認證:需要 Bearer JWT 或 X-API-Key,權限 apikey:revoke。

404.description: Unknown key or another tenant's key (NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Returns an access token (15 minutes by default) and a single-use refresh token. Ten consecutive failures lock the account for fifteen minutes. 認證:匿名(本端點用於取得憑證)。
post.summary: Log in with email and password

post.description: Revokes every refresh token in the presented token's family. Access tokens are short-lived and are not blacklisted. 認證:以請求主體中的 refresh token 認證,不需 Authorization 標頭。
Exchanges a refresh token for a new pair. The presented token is consumed; replaying an already-used token revokes the whole token family. 認證:以請求主體中的 refresh token 認證,不需 Authorization 標頭。

401.description: Unknown, revoked, expired or reused token (UNAUTHENTICATED)

post.description: Creates a user together with a new INDIVIDUAL tenant and enrols the user as its TENANT_ADMIN, then returns a session. Passwords are stored as BCrypt hashes only. 認證:匿名(本端點用於取得憑證)。

get.description: Returns UP when the API is able to serve requests. Dependency health (database, etc.) is exposed separately at /actuator/health. 認證:匿名。

Lists visible indicators ordered by (lastSeen DESC, id DESC). Filters: type, severity, status, tlp, tags (repeat the parameter; all must match), sourceId, confidenceMin/Max, scoreMin/Max, lastSeenFrom/To (ISO-8601); EXPIRED entries are excluded unless includeExpired=true. limit above the plan maximum is clamped, not rejected. offset mode is for page-number UIs only and is capped at 10000. 認證:匿名(僅 public TLP:CLEAR)。

post.description: Verifies up to the plan limit of values in one call (anonymous: 20). Values are cleaned and normalized before identity matching; unparsable or invisible values are reported as found=false, never as errors. Bloom-filter clients must confirm hits here (11 §11.6). 認證:匿名。

Substring search over the canonical (normalized) value with the same filters and cursor pagination as the list endpoint (type, severity, status, tlp, tags, sourceId, confidence/score ranges, lastSeen range). M1 backs this with PostgreSQL (pg_trgm / GIN indexes); M2 swaps in Elasticsearch behind the same contract. 認證:匿名。

400.description: INVALID_REQUEST (blank query, unknown enum value, bad cursor)

get.description: Returns a single indicator by id. Cross-tenant or invisible resources are always 404 (existence is never disclosed). 認證:匿名。

Per-source observations for one indicator. Redistribution policy is enforced: for non-owner viewers only PUBLIC_REDISTRIBUTABLE and ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED records are returned (DERIVED_ONLY and INTERNAL_ONLY are masked). 認證:匿名。

200.description: Visible source records (may be empty when policy masks them)

get.description: All configured threat sources with their TLP defaults, redistribution policy snapshot basis and health status. 認證:匿名。
A single source by id. 認證:匿名。
Sync health for one source: status transitions (ACTIVE/DEGRADED/FAILED/DISABLED), consecutive failures, timestamps and masked last error. 認證:匿名。
Indicator counts, enablement, health status and last success time per threat source. 認證:匿名。

Total visible ACTIVE indicators, distribution by type and the last-7-day trend (daily counts by lastSeen, zero-filled). Scoped by the caller's visibility — anonymous callers see public TLP:CLEAR data only. 認證:匿名。

Exports visible, redistributable indicators plus the referenced TLP 2.0 marking-definitions as one STIX 2.1 bundle. Object count is capped by plan (PLAN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED above the cap). 認證:stix:export——匿名不可用;M1 尚無登入流程,一律回 403,Phase 13 起依 RBAC 判定。

Returns a stored STIX 2.1 object by its STIX id: indicator projections (indicator--{uuid}) after visibility and redistribution filtering, and the five fixed TLP 2.0 marking-definitions served from constants. 認證:匿名。

parameters.description: STIX id, e.g. indicator--{uuid} or marking-definition--{uuid}
parameters.name: stixId

200.description: The STIX object (verbatim stored JSON for indicators)

get.description: Returns the API contract version (v1) and the build version of the running application (dev when running from sources). 認證:匿名。
